purpose: Unknown joint likelihood and state-changing paid control; classical plug-in DP, not a new RL algorithm
sampling: Nested prefixes of one maximum-size bank per world and seed; eight labeled reset rows; all maximum-size data actually collected and charged
completion: Joint (label,duration,next_state); completed failures apply next_state; label -1 is failure
cancellation: All integer caps from one to remaining deadline are legal. A duration greater than cap yields only timeout,cap,current_state; transition occurs atomically on completion, so timeout leaves state unchanged
accounting: Each launched intervention pays its fee once, including failure and timeout; consumed simulated duration is charged once; no unobserved completion label or next_state is disclosed

policy_meanings.plugin_dp: Same-paid-data exact finite belief planning: proposed method and classical planning baseline are the same policy
policy_meanings.no_duration: Coarsen posterior likelihood over completed durations but retain consumed time and next_state
policy_meanings.no_state: Retain observations but plan future value as if current state persisted; actual newly observed state used at next decision
policy_meanings.known_oracle: True-law diagnostic only; excluded from deployable gate and acquisition cost comparisons

confirmation.paired: Same H and independent action/state/step uniform array shared across frozen policies; no selection using confirmation
confirmation.costs: Every policy execution is charged its realized launches and duration, plus one label and state reset; sharing random numbers gives no free query

statistics.ci: One-sided Hoeffding union bound over 144*4 paired policy contrasts and 144 absolute candidate utilities; no optional stopping
statistics.tv: Weissman row TV bound plus exact deterministic smoothing-mixture bound; union across all 8*24 rows; vacuous bounds retained

endpoints: exact true utility and fitted utility
uniform kernel TV error and bound event
paired confirmation mean and confidence lower bound
quality, launches, failures, timeouts, cost and simulated time
full realized calibration and confirmation acquisition spend
amortized lifecycle utility and break-even deployment count

amortization.primary_training_cost: Full maximum-size calibration bank actually collected for the world and seed, including unused prefixes; prefix-only expense reported separately as counterfactual
amortization.candidate_validation_cost: Candidate confirmation receipts; global audit also sums every distinct experiment/policy execution
amortization.comparison: Same-bank baseline shares the entire calibration expense; STOP baseline has zero acquisition cost. Incremental cost is subtracted before claiming lifecycle improvement
amortization.gate: Per-cell positive-net-evidence requires absolute lifecycle LCB>0 and lifecycle paired LCB>0 against STOP, myopic, no_duration and no_state at primary N; boundary cells may correctly show ties. There is no aggregate scaling or new-RL gate, because the identical same-data DP is the method and this is a simulator.

prohibited: retuning world or cost parameters after seeing any confirmation
choosing calibration seed or sample size on confirmation
calling simulated duration hardware wall time
calling simulator accounting real provider expenditure
claiming delta-PAC identification or new RL novelty from this Bayes experiment
runtime: Hardware perf_counter measured for implementation performance only; not a utility price or LLM execution
failure_rule: Retain every negative outcome and inconclusive certificate; parameter changes require a new protocol and untouched new bank
